metadata.scenario: A client is confused about a discrepancy between the quoted price and the amount charged on their bill. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret, this is Harold Gonzalez. I'm calling about a billing issue I noticed. Hi, Harold! I’m glad you called. Can you tell me more about the issue? Yes, I was quoted $95 for my last nursing visit, but I was charged $115. I don’t understand why there’s a discrepancy. I’m sorry to hear that, Harold. Let me pull up your account and details on that visit. Thank you. My wife was present during the visit, and we both heard the quoted price. I appreciate your patience. It looks like there was an additional fee for extended service time. But I wasn’t informed about any extra charges. It's very confusing. I understand, Harold. I’ll investigate this further to ensure you’re charged correctly. That would be great. I just want to make sure everything is clear and accurate. Of course. I’ll review your service notes and reach out to you by tomorrow with an explanation. Okay, I appreciate that. Can I also request a Spanish-speaking caregiver for my next visit? Absolutely! I’ll make a note to ensure a Spanish-speaking nurse is assigned. Thank you! I just want my wife to feel comfortable during the visits. That’s very important, and we’ll make sure of it. Is there anything else I can help you with today? No, that’s all for now. Just the billing issue and caregiver preference. Got it. I’ll follow up on the billing by tomorrow and confirm the caregiver. Thanks, Margaret. I really appreciate your help with this. You’re welcome, Harold! Thank you for being a valued client. Take care! You too, bye! Bye!
